Gene
Get a gene data package by GeneID

params.name: gene_ids
params.description: One or more NCBI GeneIDs

params.name: include_annotation_type
params.description: Specify which sequence files to include in the data package.

params.name: accession_filter
params.description: Limit the contents of the sequence files and tabular product report to the specified RNA and protein accessions

params.name: aux_report
params.description: Specify additional report files to include in the data package. The gene data report is always included, and its inclusion is not affected by this parameter.

params.name: tabular_reports
params.description: Specify which tabular report files to include in the data package.

params.name: filename
params.description: Output file name.

items.docs: Download a gene data package including sequence, annotation and data reports, as a compressed zip archive, by GeneID.

info.name: Get gene reports by GeneID

params.name: returned_content
params.description: Return complete gene reports, or abbreviated reports with either GeneIDs only or GeneIDs, transcript and protein counts.

params.name: gene_ids
params.description: One or more NCBI GeneIDs

params.name: locus_tags
params.description: Gene locus tags

params.name: table_fields
params.description: Specify which fields to include in the tabular report. Additional fields are described here: [Create a table from the gene data reports](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/datasets/docs/v2/command-line-tools/using-dataformat/gene-data-reports/). Use of this parameter requires the HTTP header, `accept: text/tab-separated-values`.

params.name: include_tabular_header
params.description: Specify when to include the table header when requesting a tabular report.

params.name: page_size
params.description: The maximum number of gene reports to return. Default is 20 and maximum is 1000. If the number of results exceeds the page size, `page_token` can be used to retrieve the remaining results.

params.name: page_token
params.description: A page token is returned when the results count exceeds `page size`. Use this token along with previous request parameters to retrieve the next page of results. When `page_token` is empty, all results have been retrieved.

params.name: accession_filter
params.description: Filter tabular product report to only include the selected accessions. Use of this parameter requires the HTTP header, `accept: text/tab-separated-values`.

params.name: tax_search_subtree
params.description: If true, include genes from taxonomic ranks below the requested taxon.

items.docs: Get a gene summary by GeneID. By default, in paged JSON format, but also available as tabular (accept: text/tab-separated-values) or json-lines (accept: application/x-ndjson)

params.name: page_token
params.description: A page token is returned when the results count exceeds `page size`. Use this token along with previous request parameters to retrieve the next page of results. When `page_token` is empty, all results have been retrieved.
